title: Fosley
description: Solution: ||Wait for him to throw one of his minions at you, then bait them into a trapdoor which will fling them at Fosley. Repeat this three times.||

title: Baron Dante
description: Solution: || - Phase 1: Avoid his shockwave attacks by jumping, then run in and tail swipe him in the face while he's crying. Repeat this three times, you big meanie. - Phase 2: Dodge out of the way as he charges into the wall, then while he's hurt go and tail swipe him in the face. Repeat this three times. Again, quite mean. - Phase 3: Run in circles to avoid his lightning zaps, then run up and tail swipe him in the face after he lands. Repeat this three times.||

description: Solution: ||Let Neptuna approach and then dash out of the way. After their attack, swim close and tail swipe. Repeat this three times. Beware after the second hit, they will shoot electric balls that you need to avoid.||

title: Chumly the Rocket Man
description: Solution: ||Stand still and let Chumly move above you, then move out of the way before he drops down. When he's on the floor, slam the ground next to him. Repeat this three times.||

title: Itsy the Ice Demon
description: Solution: ||Let Itsy get close enough and then avoid his attack. While he's dazed after his attack, jump and tail swipe his head. Each time he's hit, he will split into smaller and smaller versions. Repeat the tactic until only the smallest versions are left which will roll toward you. Time a jump and smash attack to defeat them.||
